notes.title: Small But Mighty Update: Bug Fixes, Tooltip Tweaks & Sacrificial Pit Rebalance!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just rolled out a small update this week with a few handy improvements:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b] - Minor bug fixes across the game and mission, improved stability and experience.
[b]Sacrificial Pit Rebalance[/b] - The Sacrificial Pit is now much more useful. Yield increased for Primary Resource from 100 → 1000. This will better fit our narrative that the Sacrificial Pit should utilize 100 / 150 / 200 sacrificed Sinners should be utilized more effectively and yield a good amount as compared to the 10 Sinners sacrificed in the Sulking Refinery / Needle Cage / Dead Hope.
[b]Tooltips Additions [/b]- Added missing tooltips to several icons in the building panel, especially for Brewery and Cauldron crafting recipes. It should now be much easier to understand what goes on inside those buildings!

That’s all for now. we’ll be back next week with more fixes and refinements.

In the meantime, keep the feedback coming! We love reading every message from you guys and genuinely take your thoughts into account.

Cheers!

notes.title: New Patch Release v4.2.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone

The festive season is right around the corner and it is no different in our game and our studio! We have added a new seasonal greetings in our game along with many bug fixes as we head towards the end of 2024! 🎄 

Some highlights off this weeks release is that of the Bi-Directional pathfinding which improves the calculation time for all the units!
We have also ironed out a memory leak issue that would shoot up the game's RAM usage to 100% and eventually crash the game.
Other than that, we have squished many of the pesky bugs lying around The HELL to make the game even more stable and enjoyable.

May the bells jingle with muffled cries of Sinners and your stockings be filled with malice.

[h1]Release 4.2.3[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Main Menu Screen updates color based on the latest save file. Try discovering all the colors!
[*] An update to the load game UI.
[*] Implemented a new frame to the Statistics Page where all Missions now will share the same UI.
[*] New Game Save file detection. We cannot support files older than certain version due to constant updates.
[*] Bi-directional pathfinding. Reduces pathfinding computing effort by half (almost)!
[*] Added noise and deviation to unit movement to simulate organic movement.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Description of Sinners would overflow its frame.
[*] Reduced the camera shake intensity for orthographic camera.
[*] Gold Mine did not have an icon within the Statistics Page.
[*] Some button had the wrong collision boxes, causing them to be smaller than expected. Adjusted the collision boxes to the right sizes now.
[*] Blood Hall was displaying the wrong image in the Building Panel.
[*] Padding would go off if switching the view between Buildings and Units.
[*] The Eternal Servitude conversion buttons would go off position if the Sacrificial Pit was sacrificing Sinners during that time.
[*] Save Game file would not deselect after loading a game. This caused any restart game function to load game instead.
[*] Mission 2 had dialogues that were not playing.
[*] Clicking the Back button again, before the transition was finished in the the Main Menu Settings page to constantly "bounce".
[*] Building that were pre-populated were being highlighted.
[*] Tweaked the usage and scripts of the Blood Golem to enhance them.
[*] Bloody Path priority for the pathfinding has been reworked. All units prioritises walking on the Bloody Path.
[*] Loading a Save Game File will cause the buildings to generate resources without the need of a Bloody Path and Blood.
[*] Resources consumed when upgrading some buildings were incorrect. Requiring less resources than what is shown.
[*] Warehouse was displaying the capacity of Cries and Fears in reverse.
[*] Sinners could walk on water and walk over to Xolotl to give it a little pat, if they wanted. We have now removed this. Sinners cannot walk on water now.
[*] Some grids on Mission 2 were either not showing and / or not allowing structure to be built on top.
[/list]

Ho~ Ho~ Ho~

notes.title: New Patch Release v4.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone

Release 4.2.1 is now live!

In this release, have swatted many small bugs that have been infesting our game![/b]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a newly designed Settings section on the Main Menu.
[*] Introduced 9 new locales for the game. Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean, French, German, Polish, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese, Russian
[*] The "Continue" and "Load Game" button will no longer be hidden if a save game is not available. Instead it will now be greyed out and disabled.
[*] Introduced a new floor material for all Missions.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unit Detail Description Text Font Update
[*] Trying to place a building down when you do no have enough resources no longer turn off build mode. Also fixed some occasions where the "Not Enough Resources" SFX was not played.
[*] Earthquake shaking intensity has been adjusted.
[*] Preview of Paths would be stuck on the map if an Earthquake event happened while constructing paths.
[*] Game could still be played during the Decree event.
[*] Subtitles appeared much slower than the narrator's voice in Mission 2. The timinings have been fixed.
[*] Catapult disappearing in certain conditions.
[*] Side objective animation was not playing, causing a big gap within the objectives.
[*] Reduced the volume of the BGM in the final stage of Mission 1.
[*] Adjusted the Titan positions as they were in the wrong position.
[*] Addressed multiple typos in the game.
[/list]

[b]There is also a noticeable update to our Settings page in the Main Menu! You can now switch screens (provided if you have multiple) and there is an enhancement to most of our previously existing settings.

The in-game Settings page will come in another update in December.

As you can tell, the studio is slowly winding down and preparing for 2025, thus we will are shifting our development focus to bug fixes.

What this means is that we will most likely, only be introducing small 'quality of life' features, and reachable, low-hanging bug fixes.

This way I can slowly offload the team's busy schedule in time for them to enjoy the holidays with their families. (and I can torture them again in January 🙉 ).

Cheers and Happy Gaming![/b]

notes.title: New Patch Update 4.0.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to share some of the biggest changes in this update as we continue refining the game’s core mechanics:

[list]
[*] Sinners now play a key role as a resource, essential for building structures and generating resources.
[*] 
[*] Background Tasking: Haulers, Builders, and Miners now perform their tasks in the background, so there’s no need for them to reach specific spots to trigger actions like Mining Waste or Building structures.
[*] 
[*] Background Calculations: Soul Agitation, Unit attacks, Sentry protection, and Shallow stealing have all been moved to background calculations, making these systems more streamlined and efficient.
[/list]

These changes allow for a smoother gameplay experience and let us focus more on the strategic aspects. We’ve laid a strong foundation for gameplay and mechanics, though full balancing and features like the Dreadful Tree and Social State are still in progress.

By prioritising the core elements first, we’re ensuring that each gameplay component feels cohesive and engaging before moving into the finer balance adjustments. Your feedback on this reworked Mission 1 will be instrumental as we shape the game further.

Looking ahead, Mission 2 will return next week, with Mission 3 coming the week after. This phased approach lets us apply recent improvements to each mission, creating a more integrated experience.

Thank you for sticking by us as we make these big changes and constantly providing us valuable feedback!
Enjoy the update, and our entire team would like to hear your thoughts this time too!

This change is published as of 08 November 2024, 3:00PM UTC+8. Please allow some time for the changes to be reflected on your Steam build.

notes.title: New Patch Release 3.0.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re excited to announce that Mission 3's gameplay is now available, along with numerous bug fixes for Missions 1 and 2. However, we want to provide some context on the direction we're taking moving forward.

At this point, we are facing a critical decision regarding our development priorities. As a studio, we are identifying key areas in our core gameplay—particularly Hauling, Mining, and Building—that need substantial improvement to meet the standards our community expects. With that in mind, we’ve made the difficult but necessary choice to focus on these reworks, as they are vital to the long-term success of the game.

As a result, while Mission 3 is live, it is not in its final polished state. We won’t be delivering additional updates or polish for this mission in the short term as our team concentrates on overhauling the core mechanics. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we commit to enhancing the overall experience.

Thank you for your continued support—we believe this rework will lead to a better, more enjoyable game for everyone.

notes.title: New BETA Patch Release 1.3.0
notes.content:
Hi all

We wanted to keep you updated on the latest developments in our game. Thanks so much for all your feedback; we truly appreciate it! In the meantime, we’re excited to share that some players have already beaten Mission 1, which is fantastic news to hear!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Load game in the main menu and in-game ran on different functions. This has been standardised now, addressing multiple save-load game related issues.
[*] Progress when feeding Namazu Sinners was not being saved.
[*] Time to skip cutscenes reduced from 5 seconds -> 3 seconds.
[*] "Understood" button within the Tutorial was overflowing and had other elements overlapping.
[*] Submission had text that were overflowing.
[*] Game speed could be adjusted during events that should block speed controls.
[*] Game speed controls was affecting animations within UI.
[*] Hovering different categories of buildings did not have a SFX.
[*] Losing the game would make cutscenes unskippable and crash the game.
[*] Sorrow Silo was not providing Blood to the Silo Valves.
[*] Placing a Silo Valve did not have sound effect.
[*] Main objectives were overlapping with the side objectives.
[*] A building that was currently selected during an Earthquake event would not become disabled.
[*] Eternal Servitude would consume more than the required amount of Sinners for the conversion.
[*] Namazu reamined in a Unpowered state.
[*] Decree 2 along with all the voiceover and unit introductions were not triggering.
[*] Dreadful Tree did not track Souls proccessed to Sinners when researching any of the 7 deadly Sins.
[*] Removed foliages blocking the road and buildable area.
[*] Increased the font size of "Blood Producing" texts within Hearts.
[*] Mission typo "Purgetoria" changed to "Purgatoria".
[*] Namazu's choker build animation was too fast causing the choker to choker to appear even before cutscene starts.
[*] Adjusted camera offsets during the launching of the catapult cutscene.
[*] Multiple Buttons across multiple scenes had no SFX. The SFX has been added now.
[*] Many stability and gameplay issues for Mission 2.
[*] Calculations to determine the amount of resource rewarded for sacrificing units in the Sacrifice Hall had to be tweaked.
[*] Time needed to reduce 1 tick of the timer when feeding Namazu increased from 1 second -> 5 seconds. Essentially allowing players more acomplish more during the last stage.
[*] Unit dying will not close its information panel.
[*] Build time of Pandemonium was incorrectly affected by Decree selections.
[*] Salvage time of all buildings were incorrectly affected by Decree selections.
[*] Cost of build Babel of Lies was incorrectly affected by Decree selections.
[*] Health system of all units were set incorrectly, hence almost all units died within 1 hit. This has now been fixed
[*] Feeding Namazu's was missing a giant ball of Sinners. This has been fixed but the stage winning cutscene still needs a bit of tweaking.
[*] Catapult had issues gettings Sinners to "Obey" and get into the Catapul.
[*] Soul Agitation rate was incorrect towards the end of the Mission.
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced selectors for Mission 2 and Mission 3.
[*] Buildings now activate immediately upon connection to a powered path. This activation will only occur once.
[*] New pathfinding system, designed and created from the ground up. New Navmeshes have been introduced and the edge collision on all our maps have been reworked on.
[*] Units will no longer fall off the map and suddenly go missing.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

[*] Missing building icons in the "Dead Hope" and "Soldier Type" tutorials were included.
[*] Miners no longer stop working unexpectedly.
[*] Stage assignments were loaded incorrectly.
[*] Research process was corrected to require the correct number of sacrifices.
[*] Tremor debuff effects on agitation and turning rate were corrected.
[*] Dreadful Tree no longer disappears after multiple clicks on the building button.
[*] Slider adjusted to prevent negative values.
[*] Waste pile build time corrected.
[*] "Skip" function in cutscenes were prevented from triggering after the Special Unit cutscenes.
[*] Lore branches tutorial was not closing properly.
[*] Skills within the Dreadful Tree were not working when the power was toggled on and off.
[*] Research time of Lore  was incorrect.
[*] Image layering order of the Pause Menu was adjusted.
[*] Karma tooltip was displaying wrong housing information.
[*] Lose cutscene was triggering prematurely.
[*] Siren and Stalker conversion tooltips had missing information.
[*] Highlight from the tutorial for Needle Cage's labour section was not going away.
[*] Upgrade building SFX and place building SFX were prevented from triggering at the same time.
[*] Sorrow Silo had interaction issues.
[*] Stage dialogue was cut off due to Special Unit cutscenes.
[*] Building widget only corrected after build completion.
[*] Mission intro video file was missing.
[*] HUD, resource display and cutscene linking issue was fixed.
[*] Intro movie music and SFX corrected to stop after skipping.
[*] Earthquakes were triggering in mid-stages.
[*] Buildings were interactable during earthquakes.
[*] Building cost for Babel Of Lies was wrong.
[*] Building cost for Sorrow Silo was wrong.
[*] Calendar event timing was corrected.
[*] Addressed timer issues within game missions and game core.
[*] Volume slider did not follow previous value before quitting the game.
[*] Social Context was corrected to update properly in the statistics page.
[*] Mission 1 intro subtitles pace was updated.
[*] "New Game" in the Main Menu was changed to "Start Game."
[*] Fixed the wordings of multiple texts within the Main Menu.
[*] Buttons and hyperlinks linking to Discord were updated.
[*] Fixed future content popping up.
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Purgatoria sliders now only assign the percentage upon releasing the slider.
[*] Dynamic versioning implemented.
[*] Sacrificial Pit now has tooltips in the building's detail panel.
[*] Ambience volume implemented.
[*] Revised method to update resource numbers in the HUD.
[*] Random delay of 2 to 4 minutes for music.
[*] Win/Lose timer progress bar was implemented.
[*] Hover state for the building detail on/off button was added.
[*] SFX for the Pause Menu, Setting buttons, and Mission 1 intro movie were included.
[*] Tooltip screen edge detection was implemented.
[*] Widgets for disabling buildings during an earthquake and for boosting the Dreadful Tree's duration were added.
[*] Top Resource text changes to red if resources overflow.
[*] The cutscene "Skip" function now shows when any key is pressed.
[*] Per-tick cost for an active Titan Choker.
[*] Titan choker costs and cooldown.
[*] New visuals for the Titan panel tooltip, decree button and build menu tooltips.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: BETA is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi all

We are very excited to announce that you'll be able to try the city-building part of The HELL for free as a Hell Governor!

[h2]Everyone gets a key! Just a few step to get it:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Step 1:[/b] "Add to wishlist" on your steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856810/52b3bef037c4cbf684ffa09651895191666e1f0c.png[/img]

[*] [b]Step 2:[/b] Join [url=https://discord.gg/wcFW8wkqaJ]discord [/url]

[*] [b]Step 3:[/b] Screenshot your wishlisted page of The HELL and share it into discord channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856810/2976d93450516b176706f6f6ecdf89c22d22f118.png[/img]

[*] [b]Step 4:[/b] Your key will be on the way to your direct message in discord.
[/list]

[h2]How to activate the steam key?[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Step 1:[/b] Follow the steps above and get a key with this format [ABCDE-ABC12-DE345]

[*] [b]Step 2:[/b] Click "Add a game" on bottom right corner of your steam launcher

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856810/fda9473450e2f59636ab49a1c5c03b3b7861a649.png[/img]

[*] [b]Step 3: [/b] Then click "Activate a product on steam"

[*] [b]Step 4:[/b] Launch the game
[/list]

[h2]Hint[/h2]

Every Monday is a keydrop session on discord, so don't miss this chance to try it out free, let's grab the key and start playing. 

[h2]Reminder[/h2]

It's a BETA version, so we need your feedbacks, opinions and ideas. Just play it, and share everything come from your mind, whether it's good or bad. We want it!


Thank you so much. 
Hope to see you soon, Hell Governor.
